_comment: Critical actions (ADR-0026, ARV-010d): each needs a second factor (amr otp or rc) within the last 15 minutes, enforced by [RequiresRecentMfa] on the endpoint. Ariva.UnitTests (CriticalActionsTests) fails when an endpoint carries the attribute but is not listed in routes, when a listed route is not mapped with the attribute, when an endpoint guarded by a permission in criticalPermissions lacks the attribute, or when an attribute allows more than 15 minutes. The story that adds a critical endpoint adds its route here; categories is the list from the PRD that later stories map to routes and permissions.
categories: Create or reset users and TOTP
Create or regenerate integration clients and device credentials
Publish or retire a zone profile
Create, edit or delete SLA contracts
